description_en: Queries an alert whitelist rule of sensitive files that are detected by using the agentless detection feature
description_zh: 查询无代理检测敏感文件告警加白规则
name: GetMaliciousFileWhitelistConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the whitelist rule
parameters.help_zh: 无代理检测敏感文件告警加白规则ID
parameters.name: config_id

Code.description_en: The response code. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful. Other status codes indicate that the request failed. You can identify the cause of the failure based on the status code
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

Count.description_en:
The number of assets on which the whitelist rule takes effect.

The value of this parameter is returned only if the value of TargetType is SELECTION_KEY
Count.description_zh:
生效的资产数量。
说明 targetType 为 SELECTION_KEY 的情况下，此字段有值
Count.title_en: target type 为 SELECTION_KEY 的情况下，此字段有值
Count.title_zh: target type 为 SELECTION_KEY 的情况下，此字段有值

EventName.description_en:
The name of the alert.

The value is fixed as ALL, which indicates all alert types
EventName.description_zh:
告警名称：
ALL：全部告警类型

Field.description_en: The field that is used in the whitelist rule

FieldValue.description_en: The value of the field that is used in the whitelist rule

Id.description_en: The ID of the whitelist rule

Operator.description_en:
The logical operator that is used in the whitelist rule.

The value is fixed as strEqual, which indicates the equality operator (=)
Operator.description_zh:
规则判定操作符：
strEqual：字符串相等

Source.description_en:
The feature to which this operation belongs.

The value is fixed as agentless, which indicates the agentless detection feature
Source.description_zh:
业务来源：
agentless：无代理检测

TargetType.description_en:
The type of the assets on which the whitelist rule takes effect. Valid values:

ALL: all assets
SELECTION_KEY: selected assets
TargetType.description_zh:
生效目标类型：
ALL：全部资产
SELECTION_KEY：通过资产选择组件选中的资产
TargetType.title_en: 范围类型,  ALL-全部资产 SELECTION_KEY- 资产选择key
TargetType.title_zh: 范围类型,  ALL-全部资产 SELECTION_KEY- 资产选择key

TargetValue.description_en:
The assets on which the whitelist rule takes effect. Valid values:

ALL: all assets
Others: selected assets
TargetValue.description_zh:
目标生效范围：
ALL：全部资产
其他：资产选择组件选中的资产范围Key

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value 200 indicates that the request was successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP请求返回的响应状态码，200表示请求发送成功

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败
